pairs.subject: Simon Peter
pairs.question: Is Simon Peter the same person in the left and right images?
pairs.left: Simon Peter mid-leap, coat clutched around his body, plunging feet-first from the boat's side into the water; Jesus standing on the beach near a charcoal fire, the beloved disciple pointing from the boat, other disciples still aboard, a heavy net of fish in the water
pairs.right: The disciples, wet from the lake, stepping onto the sand and halting as they see the fire.; A bed of glowing charcoal on the beach with fish and flatbread laid across it, the heavy dragnet heaped in the boat behind.

pairs.subject: Daniel
pairs.question: Is Daniel the same person in the left and right images?
pairs.left: Daniel, unhurt, being lifted upward out of the pit by servants' hands and ropes.; Darius kneeling at the rim with arms outstretched in gladness; a few attendants with torches; lions sitting quietly below in the pit, not attacking.
pairs.right: Daniel standing upright and calm in the center of the den, arms relaxed at his sides; Darius in a Persian court robe with royal headdress leaning at the open rim above; faint radiance and a gentle glow near Daniel suggesting the angel's presence; scattered straw on the floor.

pairs.subject: the father's house and the road where he meets his son
pairs.question: Do the left and right images show the same place (the father's house and the road where he meets his son)?
pairs.left: The father, older and gray-bearded, standing with an outstretched hand and turned toward his servants.; Two servants hurrying forward in plain tunics, one carrying a folded robe; the ragged, barefoot younger son in worn garments, head bowed.
pairs.right: The elderly father running down the track, robe flying, arms open, and the younger son in worn, ragged tunic, bowing his head near his father's shoulder.; Olive trees at the edge of the track; the wooden gate standing open behind the embracing figures.

pairs.subject: the disciples' boat on the stormy Sea of Galilee
pairs.question: Do the left and right images show the same place (the disciples' boat on the stormy Sea of Galilee)?
pairs.left: Jesus standing in the stern, arm extended and palm open toward the sea; Disciples crouched and clutching the gunwales and mast, wet cloaks, oars and rigging, sea spray easing into still water
pairs.right: Jesus lying on a cushion in the stern, roused by the disciples leaning over him; Disciples in wet tunics bailing and clinging to mast and oars; spray and waves filling the hull; faint stone village shore far off
